#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> odd(n + 1, 0);
    vector<int> even(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + (a[i - 1] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        even[i] = even[i - 1] + (a[i - 1] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0);
    }

    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<int>> cost;
    int prev = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n - 1; ++i) {
        int oc = odd[i] - odd[prev];
        int ec = even[i] - even[prev];
        if (oc == ec) {
            cost.push(abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]));
            prev = i;
        }
    }

    int sum = 0;
    int count = 0;
    while (!cost.empty() && sum <= b) {
        sum += cost.top();
        cost.pop();
        ++count;
    }

    if (count == 0) {
        cout << "0" << endl;
    } else {
        if (cost.empty() && sum <= b) {
            cout << count << endl;
        } else {
            cout << (count - 1) << endl;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
